Title:   Full Stack Developer (Front-End Focus) 
 Location:  Baltimore, MD (1 week onsite per month) 
 Duration:  6 month C2H 
 Compensation:  $65/ hour W2 
 
 Position Description: 
The Full Stack Developer's purpose is to deliver complete, functional solutions end to end, with a primary focus on designing and developing intuitive, user-centered applications and experiences. This person will be responsible for owning the user experience from concept through implementation, translating business and functional requirements into engaging, responsive interfaces, and developing production-ready applications using technologies such as React, Python, and Go. This role requires a strong foundation in UX/UI design principles, hands-on front-end development experience, and the ability to collaborate across the full technology stack, including APIs, business logic, data processing, and cloud infrastructure. This person will also be responsible for supporting cloud implementations, optimizing application performance, facilitating CI/CD pipelines, and assisting with production support. This resource will develop software following Agile Scrum development methodologies and may be asked to support existing MS solutions in addition to cloud-based applications. 
  
 Duties and Responsibilities: 
 
	 Design and develop modern, intuitive, user-centered applications using front-end technologies such as React, ensuring a seamless and engaging user experience. 
	 Translate business and functional requirements into intuitive UI/UX designs and complete, multi-tier solutions, including user interfaces, business logic, APIs, and databases. 
	 Own the user experience from concept through implementation, applying UX/UI design principles, wireframing, prototyping, and usability best practices to deliver production-ready applications. 
	 Develop and maintain application functionality using Python, Go, and other applicable technologies within the existing application development framework. 
	 Implement solutions on cloud platforms, leveraging AWS or Azure services and modern application development practices. 
	 Collaborate with back-end developers and cross-functional teams to integrate APIs, business logic, and data services with front-end applications. 
	 Follow the strategic direction of the department as a whole and provide suggestions to improve the company and department processes. 
	 Support CI/CD pipelines and facilitate application deployments. 
	 Create automated testing solutions to support quality, performance, and reliable code delivery. 
	 Balance the right solution against performance, time, cost, and value while maintaining a strong focus on usability and application quality. 
	 Work independently and lead team initiatives, contributing to technical and design decisions throughout the development lifecycle. 
	 Participate in the design and architecture of software solutions that meet business requirements, with an emphasis on user experience, application functionality, and scalability. 
	 Play a key role in data integration and middle-tier development, delivering code supporting business logic, API integrations, and data access layers. 
	 Provide technical and design documentation as required. 
	 Participate in code reviews, planning sessions, and daily status stand-ups. 
 
  
 Minimum Qualifications: 

 
	 Bachelor's degree (or any combination of foreign degrees, diplomas, or professional credentials determined to be equivalent to a bachelor's or higher degree by a qualified evaluation service) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, UX/UI Design, or related field. 
	 Five years' experience in software engineering, application development, or programming, with demonstrated experience in front-end development. 
	 Five years' experience developing full-stack applications, including hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks, back-end technologies, and API integrations. 
 
  
 Key Competencies: 

 
	 Information Seeking 
	 Analytical Thinking 
	 Learning Agility 
	 Quality Focus 
	 Time Management 
	 Creativity & Innovation 
	 Planning and Priority Setting 
	 User-Centered Design Thinking 
 
  
 Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other Key Success Factors: 

 
	 Strong experience designing intuitive, user-friendly interfaces and translating UX concepts into functional, production-ready applications. 
	 Hands-on experience developing modern web applications using React.js and related front-end technologies. 
	 Knowledge of Python development, with the ability to develop application functionality, integrate APIs, and support back-end services. 
	 Experience with Go or other back-end programming languages is a plus. 
	 Experience owning the user experience, including UI/UX design, wireframing, prototyping, and usability considerations. 
	 Ability to translate business requirements and user needs into effective application designs and technical solutions. 
	 Knowledge of cloud platforms and services, particularly AWS or Azure. 
	 Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs and working with n-tier/distributed application architectures. 
	 Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development practices. 
	 Understanding of Agile/Scrum product development and project methodology. 
	 Advanced design and development experience using object-oriented design principles and modern application architecture. 
	 Experience working with databases, SQL Server, and data integration solutions. 
	 Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and code companions is a plus. 
	 Experience supporting existing Microsoft/.NET applications is beneficial. 
	 Solution-oriented, self-motivated, able to multi-task, and willing to learn new technologies, terminology, and business concepts.
